claims: No. 1 Duke defeated No. 10 Virginia 74-70 on March 14, 2026.
Duke won their second consecutive ACC Tournament championship.
Isaiah Evans scored 20 points for Duke.
Cameron Boozer scored 13 points for Duke.
Cameron Boozer had 8 assists for Duke.
Malik Thomas scored 18 points for Virginia.
Sam Lewis scored 17 points for Virginia.
Cameron Boozer was the Tournament MVP.
Duke secured the win in the final seconds.
Duke extended their win streak to 11.
Duke entered the ACC Tournament as the top seed.
Virginia entered the ACC Tournament as the No. 2 seed.
The March 14, 2026 game was the second matchup between Duke and Virginia in the 2025-26 season.
Duke played without Patrick Ngongba II.
The game was played at the Spectrum Center in Charlotte, N.C.
